.options rshunt=1e+06 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.001 abstol=1e-06 vntol=0.001 chgtol=1e-07 gmin=1e-09
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_hf NMOS(Vto=2 Lambda=0.01 Kp=100 Rs=0.03)
.model nmos_lf NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=100 Rs=0.02)
.model Dmodel D(Is=5e-13 n=1.05 Rs=0.005 Cjo=5e-12 Tt=5e-09 Bv=650 Ibv=1e-06)
VAC n_AC_L_raw n_AC_N_raw SIN(0 282.84 50)
RAC_L_series n_AC_L_raw n_AC_L 0.05
RAC_N_series n_AC_N_raw n_AC_N 0.05
VL_PFC_SENSE n_AC_L n_L_PFC_sense 0
RL_PFC_ESR n_L_PFC_sense n_L_PFC_ser 0.01
L_PFC n_L_PFC_ser n_SW_HF 0.00048
VSW_HF_TOP_SENSE n_DC_POS n_SW_HF_TOP_dsense DC 0
MSW_HF_TOP n_SW_HF_TOP_dsense n_g_HF_TOP n_SW_HF n_SW_HF nmos_hf
DD_HF_TOP n_SW_HF n_SW_HF_TOP_dsense Dmodel
VSW_HF_BOT_SENSE n_SW_HF n_SW_HF_BOT_dsense DC 0
MSW_HF_BOT n_SW_HF_BOT_dsense n_g_HF_BOT 0 0 nmos_hf
DD_HF_BOT 0 n_SW_HF_BOT_dsense Dmodel
VSW_LF_TOP_SENSE n_DC_POS n_SW_LF_TOP_dsense DC 0
MSW_LF_TOP n_SW_LF_TOP_dsense n_g_LF_TOP n_AC_N n_AC_N nmos_lf
DD_LF_TOP n_AC_N n_SW_LF_TOP_dsense Dmodel
VSW_LF_BOT_SENSE n_AC_N n_SW_LF_BOT_dsense DC 0
MSW_LF_BOT n_SW_LF_BOT_dsense n_g_LF_BOT 0 0 nmos_lf
DD_LF_BOT 0 n_SW_LF_BOT_dsense Dmodel
VCout_SENSE n_DC_POS n_Cout_sense 0
RCout_ESR n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esr 0.01
Cout n_Cout_esr 0 0.00272 IC=400
R_LOAD n_DC_POS 0 40
B_pol n_pol 0 v='0.5 * (1 + tanh(V(n_AC_L, n_AC_N)*100))'
B_pol_sign n_pol_sign 0 v='tanh(V(n_AC_L, n_AC_N)*100)'
B_Verr n_Verr 0 v='400 - V(n_DC_POS)'
B_Vp n_Vp 0 v='V(n_Verr) * 0.01'
G_Vint 0 n_Vint n_Verr 0 0.1
C_Vint n_Vint 0 0.001 IC=28.28
R_Vint n_Vint 0 1e+08
B_PI_out n_PI_out 0 v='max(0, min(45, V(n_Vp) + V(n_Vint)))'
B_Iref n_Iref 0 v='V(n_PI_out) * abs(V(n_AC_L, n_AC_N) / 282.84)'
B_Iact_raw n_Iact_raw 0 v='I(VL_PFC_SENSE) * V(n_pol_sign)'
R_Ifilt n_Iact_raw n_Iact_rect 100
C_Ifilt n_Iact_rect 0 1e-07
B_Ierr n_Ierr 0 v='V(n_Iref) - V(n_Iact_rect)'
B_Duty n_duty 0 v='1 - ( abs(V(n_AC_L, n_AC_N)) / 400 ) + (0.05 * V(n_Ierr))'
B_Duty_Clamped n_duty_c 0 v='max(0.02, min(0.98, V(n_duty)))'
V_tri n_tri 0 PULSE(0 1 0 5e-06 5e-06 0 1e-05)
B_PWM n_pwm 0 v='V(n_duty_c) > V(n_tri) ? 1 : 0'
E_g_LF_BOT n_g_LF_BOT 0 VALUE = { V(n_pol) * 12 }
E_g_LF_TOP n_g_LF_TOP n_AC_N VALUE = { (1 - V(n_pol)) * 12 }
E_g_HF_BOT n_g_HF_BOT 0 VALUE = { (V(n_pol) * V(n_pwm) + (1 - V(n_pol)) * (1 - V(n_pwm))) * 12 }
E_g_HF_TOP n_g_HF_TOP n_SW_HF VALUE = { ((1 - V(n_pol)) * V(n_pwm) + V(n_pol) * (1 - V(n_pwm))) * 12 }

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc
